parts.title: Part 3 · Dictation
parts.instr: Your teacher reads the dictation. Write what you hear in the box.
chunks: We eat with a knife, fork and spoon.
I only put a little salt
The opposite of friendly is unfriendly.

parts.text: We call every meal dinner. We eat with a knife, fork and spoon. I only put a little salt and pepper on my food. I've got less money than the bank. Most people rest on Sunday, but some work. The opposite of friendly is unfriendly. There isn't enough air in the church because the windows are closed.
